```{python}
import os
from deep_translator import GoogleTranslator

# Define paths
text_folder_path = r"C:\Users\nici_\OneDrive\Desktop\Masterarbeit\Factsheets\Text"
output_folder_path = r"C:\Users\nici_\OneDrive\Desktop\Masterarbeit\Factsheets\Text\Translated_Texts"

# Create the output folder if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(output_folder_path, exist_ok=True)

# Initialize translator
translator = GoogleTranslator(source='auto', target='en')

# Dictionary to hold translated documents
translated_texts = {}

# Translate each document to English and save it as a .txt file
for file in os.listdir(text_folder_path):
    if file.endswith(".txt"):
        with open(os.path.join(text_folder_path, file), 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            raw_text = f.read()

            # Translate the text to English
            translated_text = translator.translate(raw_text)
            
            # Store translated text in the dictionary
            translated_texts[file] = translated_text

            # Define the output path for each translated file
            output_file_path = os.path.join(output_folder_path, f"translated_{file}")

            # Save the translated text as a .txt file
            with open(output_file_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as output_file:
                output_file.write(translated_text)

# Display a few examples of translated text
for file, content in list(translated_texts.items())[:3]:  # Display first 3 for brevity
    print(f"\nFile: {file}")
    print(f"Translated Text:\n{content[:500]}")

```
